validity.recommendation: Keep as operating gas pipeline; note in ResearcherNotes that this is an associated/raw-gas GOSP feeder line to the Uthmaniyah Gas Plant (not a dry sales-gas transmission trunk), and that the exact length/diameter figures are single-sourced to OPEC ASB.
validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE: Strongly confirmed by two independent Oil & Gas Journal articles on the Haradh Increment III / GOSP-3 startup (different sections/authors/dates: 'Saudi Aramco commissions Haradh GOSP-3', 2006-02-14, exploration-development section; and 'Aramco's Haradh GOSP-3 starts up', pipelines-transportation section). Both confirm a gas pipeline running from the new Haradh GOSP-3 (southernmost Ghawar) to the Uthmaniyah Gas Plant for processing, equipped with a 1,140 hp motor-driven gas compressor and two 10,460 hp motor-driven gas compressors; full facility on-stream Q2 2006 at 300,000 b/d Arabian Light crude + 140 MMscfd associated gas. This is a real, independently documented physical pipeline, not a GEM-only entity. CLASSIFICATION: Correctly recorded as a GAS pipeline (carries associated natural gas, not crude/NGL) and operated by Saudi Aramco. Caveat: it is an associated-/raw-gas GOSP-to-gas-plant feeder line (Haradh GOSP-3 -> Uthmaniyah Gas Plant), i.e. gathering-to-processing rather than a long-haul dry-gas transmission trunk; flag in notes but commodity (gas) is correct. OWNER/OPERATOR: Saudi Aramco confirmed by both OGJ articles (Aramco project, Aramco-operated facility). START YEAR (2006): corroborated independently by both OGJ articles (commissioned Jan/Q2 2006). Note the gem.wiki infobox itself leaves Start Year blank, but the worklist StartYear1=2006 is well supported. FUELSOURCE (Haradh) and ENDPOINTS (Haradh/Ahsa, Eastern Province -> Uthmaniya, Eastern Province): consistent with OGJ ('to the ...Uthmaniyah gas plant') and the documented GOSP-3 location in southern Ghawar; high confidence. DUPLICATE CHECK: Compared to roster P1905 'Haradh-Uthmaniya Gas Pipeline' (87 km, 48 in). P1907 is a DISTINCT physical line: different diameter (24/32 in vs 48 in), different length (124 vs 87 km), and specifically the GOSP-3 / Increment-III associated-gas line commissioned 2006, whereas P1905 is the earlier/larger Haradh-Uthmaniya line. Not a duplicate. SPEC CAVEAT: Length 124 km and Diameter 24, 32 in could NOT be independently corroborated — they trace only to the OPEC Annual Statistics Bulletin (ASB 2012 p.75 / ASB 2013 p.79), the GEM-cited source, which the verifier could not confirm contains 'Haradh' (OPEC ASB pipeline tables are coarse). The two OGJ articles state 'more than 160 km of oil AND gas pipeline' carrying hydrocarbons to BOTH the Abqaiq stabilization plant and the Uthmaniyah gas plant — consistent with a ~124 km gas leg but not a confirmation of that exact figure, and they give no diameter. Capacity is blank in GEM; OGJ's 140 MMscfd is the GOSP-3 facility production, not a stated pipeline throughput, so I did not stage it as pipeline capacity. Overall: real pipeline, correct commodity and owner; only caveat is single-source spec figures and feeder-line nuance.

fills.researcher_notes: Two independent OGJ articles confirm the Haradh GOSP-3 -> Uthmaniyah gas pipeline was commissioned and on-stream in 2006; consistent with status=operating.
Both OGJ articles describe a GAS pipeline to Uthmaniyah carrying ~140 MMscfd of associated natural gas; commodity=Gas confirmed.
Source gas originates at Haradh GOSP-3 (southern Ghawar / Haradh field) per OGJ; FuelSource=Haradh confirmed.
OGJ confirms the gas pipeline runs from Haradh GOSP-3 (Haradh area, southern Ghawar, Eastern Province) to the Uthmaniyah gas plant (Eastern Province). Endpoints Haradh/Ahsa -> Uthmaniya confirmed.

The exact 124 km figure is NOT independently corroborated. It traces only to OPEC ASB (GEM-cited). OGJ states 'more than 160 km of oil AND gas pipeline' to BOTH Abqaiq and Uthmaniyah combined, which is consistent with a ~124 km gas leg but does not confirm it. Leaving length ref UNRESOLVED rather than attaching OGJ as if it confirmed the number; pipeline existence ref attached only as supporting context.
Diameter 24, 32 in could not be independently corroborated. No verifiable non-GEM, non-OPEC-ASB source states the diameter; OGJ gives no diameter. Leaving UNRESOLVED; do not fabricate a ref.
Haradh GOSP-3 and its gas pipeline to Uthmaniyah are Saudi Aramco facilities, built and operated by Saudi Aramco per both OGJ articles. Owner/operator = Saudi Aramco (100%) confirmed.

summary: P1907 Haradh-3-Uthmaniya gas pipeline is REAL (2 independent OGJ articles, Haradh GOSP-3 -> Uthmaniyah Gas Plant, 2006, Aramco, ~140 MMscfd associated gas); confirmed gas + owner; caveat = associated/raw-gas GOSP feeder line and length 124km/diam 24,32in single-sourced to OPEC ASB (unconfirmed); not a duplicate of P1905.
